ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all Business Administration majors on April 17, 2017 and to Finance majors on Monday, April 24, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, May 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, September 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
